name: mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server
description: Hosted AI agent memory that learns from outcomes, with shared rooms, in Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. Tell it a recalled memory helped or misled, and it re-ranks what comes back next; share a memory pool with other agents through rooms. Install: `npx -y @mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server@latest` (starts without a key; every tool call needs a free API key from https://console.mnemoverse.com). Transport: `stdio`, `streamable-http` (`https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp`, OAuth); 10 tools; clients: Claude, Cursor, VS Code, ChatGPT, and other MCP clients; MIT. Site: https://mnemoverse.com. Official Registry: `io.github.mnemoverse/mcp-memory-server`.
